buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA 1. The contractor/vendor who has successfully completed Services for Fabrication/Press work of any type o f ammunition boxes/carrier will be considered eligible to participate in tender. 2. The contractor/vendor are required to submit proof of successfully completed similar type of supply orde rs through tendering in the past in any Ordnance Factories. 3. Definition of Similar work : “Similar work” shall mean the Fabrication/welding/assembly or allied work of sheet-metal/steel components, ammunition boxes, crates, containers or similar fabricated items. 4. The contractor shall confirm availability of adequate skilled manpower, welding machines, tools and oth er necessary equipment required for execution of the work as per the Scope of work enclosed with the ten der and to achieve the stipulated production requirement. 5. The firm shall submit compliance to Scope of Work/Annexure ATC and other terms & conditions of the te nder duly signed and stamped. 6. Non compliance with the above pre qualification criteria or non submission of the required supporting do cuments may render the offer liable for rejection.

7. Tender without submission of above supporting documents will be summarily rejected and no further co rrespondence in this regard will be made. Note: 01 Service includes Spotting of Box C-51A, (M), P1, P2, Services for Spotting operation of Body, lid, en d & all brackets for Box C-51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular and modified, Box C-51A-P1, Box C-51A- P2, etc. The terms and conditions as per the attached Annexure “A” for Qty. 1 service (Qty. 29895 nos) SUBMISSION OF COMPLIANCE AS PER BID CONDITIONS AND ACCEPTANCE OF ATC 1. Specification : 01 Service includes Spotting of Box C-51A, (M), P1, P2, Services for Spotting operation of Body, lid, end & all brackets for Box C-51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular and modified, Box C-51A-P1 , Box C-51A-P2, etc. The terms and conditions as per the attached Annexure “A” for Qty. 1 service (Qty. 29 895 nos) 2. Scope of work/Terms and Conditions : As per Annexure “A” attached. 3. Delivery Period : As per GeM 4. Option Clause : As per GeM. 5. Earnest Money Deposit : As per GeM. 6. Performance Security Deposit : As per GeM. 7. Pre-Qualification Criteria : As per Annexure attached. 8. Warranty : Compliance of warranty for minimum 12 months period from final acceptance date of materi al. 9. Payment Terms : Payment will be made on monthly basis within 30 days after submission of Job Comple tion Certificate (JCC) along with the supporting documents i.e. Tax Invoice and submission of Tax Return/IF F on GST portal. 10. Non-involvement in cartel formation : We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cart el with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIM ITED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 11. Bidder Financial Standing : We hereby give an undertaking that “We are not under liquidation, court re ceivership or similar proceeding and not bankrupt”. 12. Inspection :Authorized representative of ED/OFBH on receipt of material at O.F. Bhusawal. 13. SAFETY NORMS: The firm shall fulfill all safety norms of OFBH and shall provide all necessary PPEs as p er requirement of the job. During execution of work if Firm’s employees are not following safety norms or f ound without required PPEs, then penalty of Rs. 1000/- per incident will be charge. Penalty amount will be deducted by concern user section at the time of preparation of JCC 14. ATC Clause : I accept all Bid terms & conditions along with Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditio ns(ATC) and also, Buyer Added Text Based ATC clauses as per above referred GEM Bid. ANNEXURE -“A” Works details Terms & Condition for Services for Spotting Operation of Body, lid, end & all brackets for Box C-51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular and modified, Box C-51A-P1, Box C-51A-P2, etc.) at O.F.Bhusaw al 1) Scope of work: - A) The firm has to carry out the work in O.F.Bhusawal premises. B) The firm shall provide adequate labors of required skill to carry out the job as per scope of work along w ith technical supervisor to monitor and control the work. C) Material handling/transportation within respective unit/shop. D) Collection of components from shop E) Spotting of all types of Brackets with Body as per Drg. & All type of Box C-51A versions F) Spotting of plate hooks & hinges to lid G) Spotting of handle clip to ends. H) Stacking of spotting boxes in the area fixed for same. I) Gauging, checking and passing, and carry out Rectification if any. J) Contractor has to spotting/fabricate above mentioned components in all respect at each and every stag e of sub assembly with gauges and passing by QA (Fy) K) The contractor should clean the spotting area on daily basis. L) PPE for Spot Welding operation to be arranged by contractor. NOTE: - Loose components like Plate hook, Catch, Hinges, Handle with handle Clip Assembly, all types of B racket, etc. will be supplied by the factory. 2) Work Shift: - The firm shall carry out subject job daily inside O.F. Bhusawal as per their working time and as per require ment demands by O.F.Bhusawal. The shift time may vary round the clock as per availability of the infrastru cture. 3) Delivery: - a) The firm should have capacity to give minimum 300/400 boxes per day per shift. b) In case of increased demands of boxes the contractor will have to provide additional workers to meet th e day to day requirement. 4) Quality: - The final job must comply with the quality requirements of O.F.Bhusawal.

5) Payment: - The firm has to keep record of manufactured boxes on day to day basis and get it signed by O. F. Bhusaw al representative records unsigned shall be void. 6) Safety & Statutory Requirements: - a) The firm shall fulfill all safety norms and shall provide necessary safety equipment e.g. gloves, shoes, w elding goggles etc as per the requirement of the job. b) The firm shall fulfill all security requirements and shall not violate any of the rules and regulations of the factory. c) The firm must arrange for Police verification of laborers, which the firm is going to engage for subject wo rk and submit the PVR to Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. d) The firm has to obey all labour laws and statutory rules applicable for above job e.g. Minimum wages A ct, Child Labour Act etc. e) Ordnance Factory Bhusawal shall not be responsible for any loss / damage to the firm and/or his men / machines during the course of the work. f) In case of any dispute, decision of the Executive Director, O.F. Bhusawal will be final and binding. g) Whatever the equipment of machinery is provided by the factory for conducting the production work ha ve to be submitted after completion of the entire S.O quantity and get it cleared from the concerned sectio n. And any lose or any idle time due to unavailability of material/ process etc. will be bear by contractor on ly. 7) Maintenance of Records: - The firm shall maintain following records on daily basis (or at appropriate frequency as per case), which m ust be endorsed by Representative of O.F.Bhusawal a) Numbers, Name and Signatures of the Workmen reporting, daily production Nos. b) Daily production status and no. of boxes serviced on daily basis. 8) PENALTY: - If the firm is not able to delivers as per the delivery requirement mentioned above they are li able for penalty of 1/3" of the Supply Order job Rate per box per day limited to the maximum of total Supp ly Order rate of the job. The penalty will be calculated on daily basis and will be integrated if necessary for any shortfall in delivery Any regular poor performance in delivery or in point of view of quality aspect etc. O.F. Bhusawal has full ri ght to short close the S.O. along with penalty. If the housekeeping and cleanliness of the work place of contractor is not found satisfactory, a penalty may be imposed in which housekeeping and cleanliness had not been carried out, limited to the maximum of 1/ 10" of total Supply Order rate of the job. 9) The firm shall report along with men within a week of placing supply order and shall start the job immed iately. For any other rules and regulations pertaining to this bid will be applicable as per latest YIL Store Procurem ent manual available of YIL site : yantraindia.co.in/en/e-library In case of any query/information please contact at ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in or 02582-222552,222907, Extn 241 . 5.
